name: Retail mapping inbox (tabs, status filter, reason, rows with category picker)
notes: Interaction targets: r{n}-category (choose category select), r{n}-menu/opt-k (open list in category-open), r{n}-map (Map), r{n}-aside, row-{n} (row that leaves on Map; row-mapped drops row 1). populated=4 open; zero=Open 0 inbox clear; empty=Mapped tab nothing yet. Data from data/<region>/mapping_inbox.json via scripts/la-pages-inbox.mjs.
